class.name: MaszynaMoverRailVehicleEnginePowerSource
class.description: [RailVehicleEnginePowerSource] simulated by the vendored Mover ([code]TMoverParameters[/code]): its configuration is written into the vehicle's Mover and its live values are read straight from it. Created by the FIZ import for a vehicle [MaszynaMoverVehicleServer] simulates; everything else reaches it through [RailVehicleEnginePowerSource].

members.member: The current collector's [code]FakePower=[/code] of the FIZ ([code]TCurrentCollector::FakePower[/code]).
